Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(List<T> items, int width, Future<R> Function(T) op, {int? limit}) async => [];

// CASE result_limit_named expect=pass
Future<void> c1(List<int> items, Future<int> Function(int) op) async {
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, 8, op, limit: 1);
}

// CASE literal_one expect=fire
Future<void> c2(List<int> items, Future<int> Function(int) op) async {
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, 1, op);
}
